articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla. – Limbach Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: LMB) (“Limbach” or the “Company”), a building systems solutions firm that partners with building owners and operators of mission-critical mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls (“MEPC”) infrastructure, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the stock market closes on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
